lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good morning David! Thanks for picking up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi Ana. Give me one second... okay, I'm here.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So last time your goal was to keep it to 3 drinks on the weekend. How did that go?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I did it 1 days, then the weekend happened.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It feels like a lot right now.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel so much better on Sunday when I don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is it mostly beer?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. We had a birthday party, there was so much food.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Lots of celebrations this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That took effort.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've always eaten late, that's how we do it at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're not sure it's worth it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the drinks on the weekend. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Having a glass of water between drinks is an easy way to slow down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the drinks on the weekend fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My granddaughter is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: It was a long weekend with family, you know how it is.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On one hand, the parties makes it really hard. On the other hand, you still want to make this work.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You kept going even on a hard week. That says a lot about you.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I need this for my head too, not just my body. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Having a glass of water between drinks is an easy way to slow down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've noticed it makes a difference.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe keep it to 2 drinks on the weekend?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 8.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 8 and not a 5?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can stick to two beers if I eat first.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If it rains I'll walk in the hallway of my building.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: the parties made this week harder, you still got 1 days in, and your plan is to keep it to 2 drinks on the weekend. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay David, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.

tags.note: Reports one day met goal; weekend slip
Wants energy back; reason for change
Plans ahead to make it work
Needs this for mental health too
Feels better about self sticking to it

flags.reason: Tells David what his life is about without permission; pushes a reframe rather than eliciting his view.
Repeats the water-between-drinks suggestion from line 25 nearly verbatim, ignoring that David did not engage with it the first time.
Asserts David will follow through after he expressed doubt about past attempts; presumptive rather than reflective.

score.summary: Ana drew out strong change talk (granddaughter, energy, confidence of 8/10) and built a concrete plan with a barrier discussion and summary. Persuading moments (lines 20, 33) and a repeated water suggestion (line 41) reduced partnership, and no explicit agenda was set.
strengths: Good complex reflections of ambivalence at lines 9 and 35 that deepened David's change talk.
Elicited specific change talk and a self-set goal with a confidence rating (lines 47-53).
Clear summary and next-contact agreement at lines 56-58.
coaching_tips: Line 20: replace the reframe about 'getting your life back' with an open question about what matters most to him.
Line 41: don't repeat the water suggestion; after a no-response, ask what he thinks might help instead.
Line 33: reflect his doubt ('You're not sure this time will be different') rather than asserting he will follow through.
Open the call with an agenda at line 1-3 so David knows what you'll cover together.
